methods.name: Small-Molecule Glass Transition Temperature Estimation
methods.reference: Koop et al. 2011, Phys Chem Chem Phys 13(40):19238-19255

methods.name: Fedors Group-Contribution Molar Volume & Density
methods.formula: Vm = sum(Delta Vi); rho = M / Vm
methods.uncertainty: approx. -5 to +5 percent vs pycnometric true density

methods.name: Hoftyzer-van Krevelen Hansen Solubility Parameters
methods.formula: delta_D = sum(Fd)/Vm; delta_P = sqrt(sum(Fp^2))/Vm; delta_H = sqrt(sum(Eh)/Vm)
methods.reference: van Krevelen 1990, Properties of Polymers (3rd ed.)

methods.name: Fixed Screening Interaction Radius Convention
methods.uncertainty: declared screening convention; band sensitivity reported

methods.name: RDKit Standard Cheminformatics Descriptors
methods.formula: MolWt, Crippen MolLogP, Ertl TPSA, Lipinski HBD/HBA
methods.uncertainty: exact by definition for MolWt/TPSA/counts; PubChem XLogP3 cross-check
methods.reference: Wildman & Crippen 1999; Ertl et al. 2000; Lipinski et al. 1997; RDKit 2026.03.5

methods.name: Deterministic Melting Point Literature Acquisition Rule
methods.formula: Priority hierarchy Table 4-1 (Primary DSC -> Alternative DSC -> Database range -> Vendor -> Stereoisomer)
methods.uncertainty: 2-5 K for primary/curated; 10 K for estimated

methods.name: Grade-Specific Polymer Literature & Manufacturer Acquisition
methods.formula: Grade-specific dry-state DSC midpoint for Tg; vendor datasheets for Mn and bulk density
methods.uncertainty: 2-5 K for Tg; datasheet specification range for Mn
